# Similarity Analysis
```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
data <- read_excel("Data.xlsx")
speciescount <- read_excel("species_inventory.xlsx")
# Map species Chinese names to English names
data <- merge(data,speciescount,by.x="Species",by.y = "Chinese_Name",all.x = TRUE)
data <- data %>% filter(Taxonomy %in% c("Bird","Mammal"))
dataF <- subset(data, Camera %in% c("F1","F2","F3","F4","F5","F6","F8","F9","FT10","FT11","FT12","FT13","FT14"))
dataQ <- subset(data, Camera %in% c("Q1","Q2","Q3","Q4","Q5","Q6","Q7","QT7","Q8","Q10","QT10"))

data_clean <- data %>% dplyr::select(Location, Camera, Common_Name, Taxonomy, Date, Number)

data_clean <- data_clean %>%
  # 1. Remove rows where Common_Name is feral dog or feral cat
  filter(!Common_Name %in% c("feral dog", "feral cat")) %>%
  
  # 2. Remove rows where Camera is one of the FT series listed
  filter(!Camera %in% c("FT10", "FT11", "FT12", "FT13", "FT14")) %>%
  
  # 3. Rename QT7 to Q7 and QT10 to Q10
  mutate(Camera = case_when(
    Camera == "QT7" ~ "Q7",
    Camera == "QT10" ~ "Q10",
    TRUE ~ Camera # Keep all other camera names the same
  )) %>%
  
  # 4. Rerank (sort) the dataframe by Camera
  arrange(Camera)

data_clean <- subset(data_clean, Taxonomy == "Mammal")

library(tidyverse)
community_matrix <- data_clean %>%
  # distinct() ensures we only count presence once per camera (0/1), not abundance
  distinct(Camera, Common_Name) %>% 
  mutate(Present = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Common_Name, 
    values_from = Present, 
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  # Convert the 'Camera' column to Row Names (required for vegan package)
  column_to_rownames(var = "Camera")

metadata <- data_clean %>%
  distinct(Camera, Location) %>%
  # CRITICAL: Reorder metadata rows to match the community_matrix exactly
  slice(match(rownames(community_matrix), Camera)) %>%
  # Set row names to match the matrix for safety
  column_to_rownames(var = "Camera")

library(vegan)
dist_matrix <- vegdist(community_matrix, method = "jaccard", binary = TRUE)

anosim_result <- anosim(dist_matrix, metadata$Location)

nmds_result <- metaMDS(dist_matrix, k = 2, trymax = 100)

# Extract scores for plotting with ggplot
nmds_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(nmds_result, display = "sites"))
nmds_scores$Location <- metadata$Location
nmds_scores$Camera <- metadata$Camera

# Calculate Convex Hulls
hull_data <- nmds_scores %>%
  group_by(Location) %>%
  slice(chull(NMDS1, NMDS2))

zone_colors <- c(
  Fushan = "#D55E00",
  Qishan = "#0072B2")
# Plot
ggplot(nmds_scores, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, color = Location, fill = Location)) +
  # Draw the convex hulls
  geom_polygon(data = hull_data, alpha = 0.3) +
  # Draw the points (Cameras)
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  # Add text labels (optional, can be cluttered)
  # geom_text(aes(label = Camera), vjust = 1.5, size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_manual(values = zone_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = zone_colors)+
  labs(
    title = "NMDS of Species Composition by Zone",
    subtitle = paste("Stress:", round(nmds_result$stress, 3), 
                     "| ANOSIM R:", round(anosim_result$statistic, 3), 
                     "p =", anosim_result$signif),
    x = "NMDS 1",
    y = "NMDS 2"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, size=1)
  )

```

# Similarity Analysis II: only use periods when both Qishan and Fushan cameras were operating
```{r}
# ===============================================================================
# 1. Load required R packages
# ===============================================================================
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(lubridate)
library(vegan)

# ===============================================================================
# 2. Read and process camera deployment history, extract overlapping working dates
# ===============================================================================
camera_info <- read_excel("Fuzhou_Camera_info.xlsx")

# Expand the wide table into a daily time series
camera_dates <- camera_info %>%
  dplyr::select(Location, Camera, starts_with("Install"), starts_with("Check")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(c("Install", "Check")),
    names_to = c(".value", "Period_ID"),
    names_pattern = "(Install|Check)(\\d+)",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) %>%
  # Normalize character/Excel date formats to Date
  mutate(
    Install = ymd(Install),
    Check = ymd(Check)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Install) & !is.na(Check)) %>%
  # Expand each working period to a daily sequence
  mutate(Daily_Sequence = map2(Install, Check, ~seq(.x, .y, by = "day"))) %>%
  unnest(Daily_Sequence) %>%
  dplyr::select(Location, Camera, Daily_Sequence)

# Extract unique dates where cameras were operating for the two sites
fushan_dates <- camera_dates %>% filter(Location == "Fushan") %>% pull(Daily_Sequence) %>% unique()
qishan_dates <- camera_dates %>% filter(Location == "Qishan") %>% pull(Daily_Sequence) %>% unique()

# Intersection: dates when both Fushan and Qishan had cameras operating
# Note: intersect may coerce Date to numeric; use as.Date to restore Date class
overlap_dates <- as.Date(intersect(fushan_dates, qishan_dates), origin = "1970-01-01")

cat("Number of overlapping days when both sites were operating:", length(overlap_dates), "days\n")

# ===============================================================================
# 3. Read and clean species records, apply overlap_dates filter
# ===============================================================================
data <- read_excel("Data.xlsx")
speciescount <- read_excel("species_inventory.xlsx")

# Map species Chinese names to English names
data <- merge(data, speciescount, by.x="Species", by.y = "Chinese_Name", all.x = TRUE)

data_clean <- data %>% 
  dplyr::select(Location, Camera, Common_Name, Taxonomy, Date, Number) %>%
  filter(Taxonomy %in% c("Bird", "Mammal")) %>%
  
  # Apply standard cleaning rules
  filter(!Common_Name %in% c("feral dog", "feral cat", "bat", "rat", "shrew")) %>%
  filter(!Camera %in% c("FT10", "FT11", "FT12", "FT13", "FT14")) %>%
  mutate(Camera = case_when(
    Camera == "QT7" ~ "Q7",
    Camera == "QT10" ~ "Q10",
    TRUE ~ Camera
  )) %>%
  
  # Key step: convert Date format and keep only records within overlap_dates
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date)) %>%
  filter(Date %in% overlap_dates) %>%
  
  # Filter target taxa (Example here uses Bird)
  filter(Taxonomy == "Bird") %>%
  arrange(Camera)

# ===============================================================================
# 4. Build community matrix and metadata
# ===============================================================================
community_matrix <- data_clean %>%
  # Ensure each camera-species pair is counted once (presence/absence)
  distinct(Camera, Common_Name) %>% 
  mutate(Present = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Common_Name, 
    values_from = Present, 
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "Camera")

# If strict date filtering causes some cameras to have no records in the intersection,
# they will disappear from the matrix. This is the correct ecological handling (remove all-zero samples).
metadata <- data_clean %>%
  distinct(Camera, Location) %>%
  slice(match(rownames(community_matrix), Camera)) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "Camera")

# ===============================================================================
# 5. Community analysis: NMDS and ANOSIM
# ===============================================================================
# Compute Jaccard distance matrix (suitable for binary presence/absence)
dist_matrix <- vegdist(community_matrix, method = "jaccard", binary = TRUE)

# ANOSIM analysis
anosim_result <- anosim(dist_matrix, metadata$Location)

# NMDS ordination
nmds_result <- metaMDS(dist_matrix, k = 2, trymax = 100)

# ===============================================================================
# 6. Data visualization (ggplot2)
# ===============================================================================
# Extract coordinates for plotting
nmds_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(nmds_result, display = "sites"))
nmds_scores$Location <- metadata$Location
# Fix potential bug when extracting Camera names (use rownames of metadata)
nmds_scores$Camera <- rownames(metadata)

# Calculate convex hull boundaries
hull_data <- nmds_scores %>%
  group_by(Location) %>%
  slice(chull(NMDS1, NMDS2))

zone_colors <- c(
  Fushan = "#D55E00",
  Qishan = "#0072B2"
)

# Plot NMDS scatter
ggplot(nmds_scores, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, color = Location, fill = Location)) +
  geom_polygon(data = hull_data, alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  # To show camera labels, uncomment the line below
  # geom_text(aes(label = Camera), vjust = 1.5, size = 3, show.legend = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_manual(values = zone_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = zone_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "NMDS of Mammal Species Composition by Zone (Overlapping Dates Only)",
    subtitle = paste("Stress:", round(nmds_result$stress, 3), 
                     "| ANOSIM R:", round(anosim_result$statistic, 3), 
                     "p =", anosim_result$signif),
    x = "NMDS 1",
    y = "NMDS 2"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, size = 1)
  )
```


# RAI ranking
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
speciescount

data_qishan <- speciescount %>%
  # Sort by Qishan RAI descending
  arrange(desc(Qishan_RAI)) %>%
  # Take top 10
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  # Select and rename columns to a common format
  select(Common_Name, Taxonomy, RAI = Qishan_RAI) %>%
  mutate(Location = "Qishan")

# --- 2. Prepare Data for Fushan ---
data_fushan <- speciescount %>%
  # Sort by Fushan RAI descending
  arrange(desc(Fushan_RAI)) %>%
  # Take top 10
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  # Select and rename columns to a common format
  select(Common_Name, Taxonomy, RAI = Fushan_RAI) %>%
  mutate(Location = "Fushan")

# --- 3. Combine and Order ---
plot_data <- bind_rows(data_qishan, data_fushan) %>%
  mutate(
    # CRITICAL STEP:
    # Create a unique identifier for the X-axis (Species + Location).
    # This allows "Muntjac" in Qishan to be sorted differently than "Muntjac" in Fushan.
    Species_Unique = paste0(Common_Name, "__", Location),
    
    # Order this new factor by RAI (descending)
    Species_Unique = fct_reorder(Species_Unique, RAI, .desc = TRUE)
  )

# --- 4. Plot ---
p7 <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Species_Unique, y = RAI, fill = Taxonomy)) +
  geom_col() +
  
  # Group by Location using facets
  # scales = "free_x" is REQUIRED to let each side have its own sorted list
  facet_wrap(~ Location, scales = "free_x") + 
  
  # Clean up the X-axis labels (remove the "__Location" suffix we added)
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) str_remove(x, "__.*")) +
  
  # Labels and Theme
  labs(x = "Species", y = "Relative Abundance Index (RAI)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), # Cleaner look for bars
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12)
  )

ggsave(
  "Figure_7.png",
  plot = p7,
  width = 6,
  height = 4,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white" 
)
```

# GLM: calculate species number differences (old)
```{r}
library(MASS)
library(tidyverse)

data_time_controlled <- data_clean %>%
  # 1. Ensure the Date column is properly formatted as a Date object
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date)) %>% 
  # 2. Filter for the date range (inclusive)
  filter(Date >= as.Date("2024-07-05") & Date <= as.Date("2025-02-10"))

data_clean <- subset(data_time_controlled, Taxonomy == "Mammal") %>%
  filter(!Common_Name %in% c("bat", "rat","shrew"))
glm_input <- data_clean %>%
  group_by(Location, Camera) %>%
  summarise(
    # Count distinct species names. 
    # The condition inside brackets ensures "No_Species_Detected" is not counted.
    Species_Number = n_distinct(Common_Name[Common_Name != "No_Species_Detected"]),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

monitoring_days <- read_excel("monitoring_days.xlsx")
glm_input <- glm_input %>% 
  left_join(monitoring_days %>% dplyr::select(Camera, Duration), by= "Camera")

model_nb <- glm.nb(Species_Number ~ Location + offset(log(Duration)), data = glm_input, control = glm.control(maxit = 100))
summary(model_nb)
# Excluding FT cameras: p = 0.187; including them: 0.433

d_squared <- 1 - (model_nb$deviance / model_nb$null.deviance)
# bird
```

# GLMM calculate species number differences — latest version moved to FZ_new
```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyverse)
library(glmmTMB) # for fitting GLMMs
library(MuMIn) # for GLMM R-squared (used at end)

data <- read_excel("Data.xlsx")
speciescount <- read_excel("species_inventory.xlsx")
# Map species Chinese names to English names
data <- merge(data,speciescount,by.x="Species",by.y = "Chinese_Name",all.x = TRUE)
data <- data %>% filter(Taxonomy %in% c("Bird","Mammal"))
data_clean <- data %>% dplyr::select(Location, Camera, Common_Name, Taxonomy, Date, Number)

data_clean <- data_clean %>%
  # 1. Remove rows where Common_Name is feral dog or feral cat
  filter(!Common_Name %in% c("feral dog", "feral cat")) %>%
  
  # 2. Remove rows where Camera is one of the FT series listed
  #filter(!Camera %in% c("FT10", "FT11", "FT12", "FT13", "FT14")) %>%
  
  # 3. Rename QT7 to Q7 and QT10 to Q10
  mutate(Camera = case_when(
    Camera == "QT7" ~ "Q7",
    Camera == "QT10" ~ "Q10",
    TRUE ~ Camera # Keep all other camera names the same
  )) %>%
  
  # 4. Rerank (sort) the dataframe by Camera
  arrange(Camera)

# 1. Time filtering (fixes overwriting issues in original code, avoids overwriting original data_clean)
data_time_controlled <- data_clean %>%
  # Ensure Date column is a Date object
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date)) %>% 
  # Filter date range
  filter(Date >= as.Date("2024-07-05") & Date <= as.Date("2025-02-10"))

# 2. Taxa filtering
data_filtered <- data_time_controlled %>%
  filter(Taxonomy %in% c("Mammal", "Bird")) %>% 
  # Exclude unwanted species
  filter(!Common_Name %in% c("bat", "rat", "shrew", "leaf warbler"))

# 3. Count species: include Taxonomy in grouping to produce long data
glmm_input <- data_filtered %>%
  group_by(Location, Camera, Taxonomy) %>% 
  summarise(
    Species_Number = n_distinct(Common_Name[Common_Name != "No_Species_Detected"]),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  # Critical fix: ensure every (Location, Camera) has both Mammal and Bird rows
  # If missing, complete and fill Species_Number with 0
  complete(nesting(Location, Camera), Taxonomy, fill = list(Species_Number = 0))

# 4. Join camera effort
monitoring_days <- read_excel("monitoring_days.xlsx")

glmm_input <- glmm_input %>% 
  left_join(monitoring_days %>% dplyr::select(Camera, Duration), by = "Camera") %>%
  # Remove rows with missing Duration to avoid model errors
  filter(!is.na(Duration)) 

# 5. Fit GLMM (additive fixed effects)
# Use + to join fixed effects, Camera as random effect, negative binomial family (nbinom2)
model_glmm_add <- glmmTMB(
  Species_Number ~ Location + Taxonomy + offset(log(Duration)) + (1|Camera), 
  data = glmm_input, 
  family = nbinom2
)

# View model results
summary(model_glmm_add)

# 6. Compute model R-squared
# For mixed models we recommend MuMIn::r.squaredGLMM which returns R2m (marginal) and R2c (conditional)
MuMIn::r.squaredGLMM(model_glmm_add)
```

# GLMM RAI differences (old)
```{r}
library(glmmTMB)
library(emmeans)
monitoring_days <- read_excel("monitoring_days.xlsx")

data_shared <- data_clean %>%
  group_by(Common_Name) %>%
  # Check if the species exists in more than 1 unique location
  filter(n_distinct(Location) >= 2) %>% 
  ungroup()

abundance_camera <- data_shared %>%
  group_by(Location, Camera, Common_Name) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = sum(Number, na.rm = TRUE), # Sum the 'Number' column
    .groups = "drop"
  )

abundance_camera <- abundance_camera %>% 
  left_join(monitoring_days %>% dplyr::select(Camera, Duration), by= "Camera")

abundance_camera$RAI <- abundance_camera$Count/abundance_camera$Duration *100

abundance_camera <- abundance_camera %>% rename(Species = Common_Name)

library(glmmTMB) # Recommended for Negative Binomial models
# OR library(lme4)

# Effect of site on all shared species
model_abundance <- glmmTMB(
  Count ~ Location +                # Fixed Effect (The main question)
          offset(log(Duration)) +   # Offset (Correcting for effort)
          (1|Camera) +              # Random Effect (Spatial grouping)
          (1|Species),              # Random Effect (Controlling for species rarity)
  data = abundance_camera,
  family = nbinom2                  # Negative Binomial distribution
)

# Check the results
summary(model_abundance)
car::Anova(model_abundance)

library(performance)
r2(model_abundance)
```

```{r}
# Effect of site on each shared species
model_sp <- glmmTMB(
  Count ~ Location * Species +                # Fixed Effect (The main question)
          offset(log(Duration)) +   # Offset (Correcting for effort)
          (1|Camera),              # Random Effect (Spatial grouping)
  data = abundance_camera,
  family = nbinom2                  # Negative Binomial distribution
)

# Check the results
summary(model_sp)
car::Anova(model_sp)
r2(model_sp)

results <- emmeans(model_sp, specs = pairwise ~ Location | Species)
summary(results$contrasts)
```

# Breeding seasonality
```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
data <- read_excel("Data.xlsx")
speciescount <- read_excel("species_inventory.xlsx")

data <- merge(data,speciescount,by.x="Species",by.y = "Chinese_Name",all.x = TRUE)
data$Date <- as.Date(data$Date, format = "%Y-%m-%d")

data <- data %>%
  mutate(Desc = recode(Desc, "幼崽" = "infant",
                       "亚成"="subadult"))

species_to_include <- c("silver pheasant","Reeves's muntjac")
data_filtered <- subset(data, data$Common_Name%in%species_to_include)
data_filtered <- subset(data_filtered,data_filtered$Desc=="infant"|data_filtered$Desc=="subadult")
data_filtered <- subset(data_filtered, data_filtered$Location =="Fushan")

data_filtered$MonthDay <- as.Date(format(data_filtered$Date, "2024-%m-%d"))
data_filtered

data_filtered <- data_filtered %>%
  mutate(Desc = factor(Desc, levels = c("infant", "subadult"))) %>%  # Force order
  arrange(Desc)

p3 <- ggplot(data_filtered, aes(x = MonthDay, y = Common_Name, color = Desc)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7, position = position_jitter(height = 0.2)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("infant" = "#E41A1C", "subadult" = "#88CCEE")) +
  scale_x_date(
    date_labels = "%b",
    date_breaks = "1 month",
    expand = c(0.01, 0),
    limits = as.Date(c("2024-01-01", "2024-12-31"))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Observed Breeding Seasonality",
    x = "Month",
    y = "",
    color = "Age Category"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray90"),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    plot.margin = unit(c(5, 15, 5, 5), "pt")
  ) +
  # Vertical compression adjustment
  coord_fixed(ratio = 60)

ggsave(
  "Figure_3.png",
  plot = p3,
  width = 6,
  height = 4,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white" 
)
```
